arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox', event_id, json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'payload',json(payload),'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'booking', booking_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status!='confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds
